item.title: 米政権、緊急暖房油備蓄の3割強を貸与へ 価格抑制狙い
item.description:
Timothy Gardner
[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Timothy Gardner

[ワシントン ２１日 ロイター] - 米エネルギー省は２１日、急騰しているヒーティングオイル（暖房油）価格の抑制を目指し、１００万バレル規模の緊急暖房油備蓄の最大約３分の１を貸し出す方針を発表した。

同省は、北東部メーン、マサチューセッツ、コネティカットの各州にある暖房油備蓄から最大３１万５０００バレルを貸し出すと説明した。受け渡しは１１月１３日までに完了する予定。

この措置は、与野党の上院議員らが政府に対し備蓄から暖房油を放出するよう求めていたことを受けた動きだ。

暖房油は軽油（ディーゼル燃料）と成分が類似している。軽油価格は、イラン戦争による中東地域での混乱を背景に１ガロン当たり６．５０ドルを超える過去最高水準に達している。

エネルギー省の関係者によると、政権はさらなる備蓄放出が必要かどうかについても検証する方針だ。

米国が北東部家庭用暖房油備蓄を活用したのは、２０１２年にハリケーン「サンディ」が同地域に襲来して以来一度しかない。この緊急備蓄はニュージャージー、コネティカット、マサチューセッツ、メーン各州の施設に保管されている。

ニューイングランド地域では住宅の約３分の１が暖房油を使用しており、メーン州ではその割合が約半分に達する。

暖房油価格の高騰は、１１月３日の中間選挙を前に重要な争点として浮上している。トランプ大統領率いる共和党は連邦議会上下両院での多数派維持を目指しており、接戦となっている複数の上院選挙区にも暖房油の高騰が影響を及ぼしている。

共和党のスーザン・コリンズ上院議員（メーン州選出）は再選へ向け厳しい選挙戦に直面しているほか、ニューハンプシャー州の上院議席を巡っては、民主党のクリス・パパス氏と共和党のジョン・スヌヌ氏が互角の戦いを展開中だ。

ライト米エネルギー長官は「エネルギーコストを引き下げるために、あらゆる措置を講じる」と表明した。エネルギー省によると、燃料小売業者や石油ターミナル運営会社を対象に競争入札を実施し、燃料不足に直面する地域へ供給を行う。

一方、アナリストらはこの措置に懐疑的だ。ガルフ・オイルの首席エネルギー顧問トム・クロザ氏はＸに、この措置について「不可解であり、恐らく効果は限定的だ」と投稿し、価格への影響はないとの見方を示した。

item.title: ユナイテッド航空ＣＥＯ、燃料高止まり予想 利益率目標達成に課題
item.description:
Rajesh Kumar Singh Shivansh Tiwary
[シカゴ ２１日 ロイター] - 米ユナイテッド...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ユナイテッド航空ＣＥＯ、燃料高止まり予想　利益率目標達成に課題 13:34 配信

ユナイテッド航空機。　米フロリダ州のフォートローダーデール・ハリウッド国際空港で4月撮影。REUTERS/Marco Bello

Rajesh Kumar Singh　Shivansh Tiwary

[シカゴ ２１日 ロイター] - 米ユナイテッド航空のスコット・カービー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は２１日、燃料価格の高止まりが２０２７年を通じて続くとの見通しを示した。

カービー氏は、同社が掲げる来年の２桁の税引き前利益率目標を達成するには、燃料価格の低下や業界全体の供給能力の伸び鈍化か、搭乗率の向上よりも運賃引き上げを各社が優先し続けることが不可欠になると述べた。

ユナイテッド航空は前日、第４・四半期利益見通しとして市場予想を大幅に下回る水準を示した。同社は運賃が大幅に上昇しているにもかかわらず、収益面で燃料コスト上昇をなお十分に吸収できていない。第３・四半期において、追加的な燃料コストのうち収益増加で回収できた割合は７２％にとどまった。

カービー氏は決算説明会で、業界全体の供給能力は来年さらに拡大する見通しだと発言した。座席供給の増加は航空会社の価格決定力を弱め、燃料コスト増を補うための十分な運賃引き上げが難しくなりかねない。

ユナイテッド航空は第４・四半期の航空燃料価格を１ガロン当たり４．８０ドルと見込んでいる。業界団体エアラインズ・フォー・アメリカによると、米国の航空燃料スポット価格は２０日時点で１ガロン当たり４．７７ドルだった。

マイク・レスキネン最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）は、第４・四半期も第３・四半期と同程度の割合で燃料コスト増を回収すると予想していると述べており、従来想定していた全額回収には届かない形になる。

ユナイテッド航空は２０２７年に追加燃料コストを収益増加によって完全に回収することを目指しているが、経営陣は燃料価格上昇に対して運賃値上げが追いつくまでには時間がかかると認めている。

カービー氏は、製品や技術への投資によって来年の収益拡大が期待できるとしながらも、それだけでは２桁の税引き前利益率達成には十分ではないだろうと予想した。

ユナイテッド航空は、全ての路線と市場における供給能力を精査しており、２７年の運航計画についても柔軟に対応する方針を打ち出した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：ＡＩ関連の資金調達、低格付け領域にも拡大　投資家は警戒感強める アングル：世界の航空運賃高止まりか、燃料費負担軽減でも乗客に恩恵届かず アングル：航空会社の機内Ｗｉ―Ｆｉ競争過熱、スターリンクとアマゾンが主導権争い アングル：ユナイテッド航空のアメリカン合併案、反トラスト法懸念で懐疑論 焦点：米航空会社、感謝祭目前で政府閉鎖の影響に苦慮 最終更新: 10/22(木) 13:34 ロイター

item.title: トルコ、サウジへの軍要員派遣承認案を議会に提出へ＝与党議員
item.description: [アンカラ ２１日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[アンカラ ２１日 ロイター] - トルコは、サウジアラビアおよびパキスタンとの共同防衛協定に基づき、サウジへの軍要員派遣を可能にする議案を議会に提出する。与党・公正発展党（ＡＫＰ）の議員が２１日、匿名を条件にロイターに語った。

軍要員派遣の承認案は協定の批准法案が可決され次第、議会に送付されるという。

トルコは２０日、３カ国が８月に署名した「メッカ共同防衛協定」を批准に向けて議会に提出した。これにより、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）で軍の規模が２番目に大きいトルコは、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派の攻撃を受けるサウジとの正式な相互防衛の約束に一歩近づいた。

同議員は、協定に基づき他国に派遣されるトルコ軍部隊が攻撃作戦に参加することはないと説明。当初は技術要員や専門家を派遣し、防空や電子戦技術、その他の防衛支援に当たるとした。

これに先立ち、２人の当局者はロイターに対し、トルコの貢献は軍事装備、情報共有、兵器システムに限られる見通しだとし、同盟の枠組みでは、これまでそれ以外の形での派遣・配備は行われていないと述べていた。

フーシ派の攻撃を非難しているトルコは、紅海での航行の安全を確保するため、サウジ主導の有志連合に参加することにも合意している。

item.title: Musk’s public endorsement of SpaceX-Tesla deal may throw a wrench in talks
item.description: Elon Musk's public endorsement of a potential $3.5 trillion merger has rattled some insiders involved in the discussions, who worry his comments could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks.
item.dc:creator: Milana Vinn
item.content:encoded: Elon Musk's [USN:L4N4661IU TEXT:"public endorsement"] this week of a potential $3.5 trillion merger between SpaceX (SPCX.O) and Tesla (TSLA.O) has rattled some insiders involved in the discussions, who worry his comments could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks, according to a person with direct knowledge of the talks. The disclosure created a "mess" for the process, as it could lead to questions about how well Tesla shareholders' interests would be represented, the person said. The concerns reflect similarities some participants see with Tesla's 2016 acquisition of SolarCity, which sparked years of litigation over Musk's role in the deal. Musk, who serves as CEO of both SpaceX and Tesla and owns significant stakes in each company, this week told investors that the two companies were examining what would be the largest corporate transaction in history and revealed that both had formed special committees to evaluate it. The backlash to those remarks is reported here for the first time. The parties have hired advisers, but discussions are at an early stage, three sources familiar with the matter said. SpaceX approached Tesla in recent weeks, and the companies have been discussing a range of transaction structures, including a SpaceX acquisition of Tesla or a merger under a newly formed holding company, the person familiar with the matter said. They are weighing different forms of merger consideration, including an all-stock deal, the person said. These details of the talks have not been previously reported. Tesla, SpaceX and Musk did not respond to requests for comment. SHAREHOLDER LITIGATION OVER TESLA'S SOLARCITY DEAL In related-party transactions such as a SpaceX-Tesla merger, independent board members typically oversee the process to safeguard public shareholders' interests. That issue loomed large in Tesla's 2016 acquisition of SolarCity, which triggered [USN:L1N36V3J9 TEXT:"years of litigation"] after shareholders alleged the world's richest man had influenced the process to bail out his investment in the struggling rooftop solar company. At the time, Musk owned roughly 22% of both Tesla and SolarCity, which was founded by his cousins. Shareholders argued that Musk's involvement and public support undermined the deal's fairness. Central to the case were [USN:L2N2OL1K9 TEXT:"claims that despite his minority stake"], Musk was a controlling shareholder of Tesla due to his ties to board members and domineering style. The Delaware Supreme Court later noted that plaintiffs' contention of the absence of an independent committee, together with "certain other facts concerning Musk's involvement in and public support for the transaction," warranted the finding of unfair dealing. The courts ultimately upheld the acquisition as fair, though it took several years for the case to be resolved and Tesla directors settled allegations for $60 million. MUSK CANNOT BE INVOLVED IN TALKS Musk owns nearly a fifth of Tesla and just under half of SpaceX, and analysts have said a merger would give him control of the combined entity. On Tuesday's call with investors, Musk acknowledged that as a conflicted party he cannot be part of the discussions of the special committees. Advisers are also in contact with his lawyers to ensure Musk is recused from the merger discussions, the source familiar with the talks said. Eric Talley, a law professor at Columbia University, said a merger could benefit shareholders by eliminating the need for Musk to divide his time between the two companies. He added that any legal challenge may be harder to predict than the SolarCity case because Tesla is now incorporated in Texas rather than Delaware. “The Texas thing is a wild card. No one knows how Texas deals with cases like this because Texas never dealt with cases like this,” Talley said, noting that Texas has sought to establish itself as a business-friendly alternative to Delaware, and Musk’s comments so far were not necessarily problematic. Ultimately, he said, litigation risk would hinge on the terms of any transaction. "Who's going to get the better side of this deal? And that's usually what gives rise to litigation," Talley said. MUSK'S COMMENTS COULD AFFECT DISCUSSIONS People involved in the process worry Musk's public endorsement of the merger and disclosure of talks could intensify investor scrutiny, as interested parties typically avoid expressing views publicly while independent directors evaluate a deal, the source said. The SolarCity case could become a reference point for investors and courts assessing any future SpaceX-Tesla transaction if advisers fail to fully insulate the special committees from Musk's influence, the source added. A tie-up between Tesla and SpaceX would be the biggest deal in history, creating one of the world's largest industrial and technology groups. It would surpass Musk's acquisition earlier this year of his artificial intelligence company xAI by SpaceX, which ranks among the largest corporate transactions ever announced. A deal of this size would also face scrutiny from global regulators, especially due to Tesla’s business in China and SpaceX’s work in US defense and AI.

item.title: ロシアとウクライナ、攻撃応酬続く 米特使は和平仲介
item.description: ［キーウ ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［キーウ　２２日　ロイター］ - ウクライナの首都キーウで２２日未明、ミサイルが着弾した。ロイター記者が明らかにした。一方、ウクライナは夜間に数百機のドローン（無人機）をロシアの首都モスクワに向けて発射した。戦争終結に向けた米国の仲介にもかかわらず、両国は激しい攻撃を続けている。

キーウ当局によると、ロシアの攻撃で１５人が負傷し、市内を流れるドニプロ川に架かる南橋の地下鉄設備が損傷。橋の通行も制限された。キーウでは２１日夕にも攻撃があり、６人が負傷している。

ウクライナ北東部ハルキウ州のシネグボフ知事は通信アプリ「テレグラム」で、ロシアの攻撃により女性１人が死亡し、他に４人が負傷したと明らかにした。

ポルタワ州クレメンチュク地区でもエネルギーインフラにドローンが着弾した。クレメンチュクは主要な工業都市で、ウクライナ最大級の製油所がある。

ロシアでは、ソビャニン・モスクワ市長がテレグラムで、夜間に６３０機のドローンが首都に向けて飛来し、近郊で２人が負傷したと明らかにした。

トランプ米政権のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使は今週、戦争終結を仲介するため、ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領、ロシアのプーチン大統領と協議した。

item.title: 自ら負傷した脚を切断 491日間前線に取り残された末に、大型ドローンで救助されたウクライナ軍兵士が体験を語る
item.description:

item.dc:creator: ロイター

救出作戦は、前線の拠点で孤立していたこの兵士との連絡を保ち、支援を届けようとする試みが1年以上続いた末に実施された。

第30機械化旅団に所属するウラセンコさんは、脚に重傷を負いながらも陣地にとどまっていた。

コスチャンティン・ウラセンコさん 「自分は死んだも同然だと思っていた。分かるだろう。491日間、ほぼ独りだった」

5年目に入ったウクライナとロシアの戦争は、戦闘でのドローン活用を象徴する事例の1つとなった。ドローンは軍事戦略を塗り替え、戦場の様相を変えており、双方がこの技術への投資を続けている。

ウラセンコさんは、救助のドローンが到着した瞬間を忘れられないと語った。

「ヘリコプターが着陸するようだった。ものすごいごう音だった。このうなり音は、一生忘れない。あの瞬間には、味さえあった。どんな味か説明できないが、確かにあった。信じられない体験だった」

ウラセンコさんは、ロシア軍のドローンが投下した弾薬で脚と首を負傷した。ここから長い試練が始まった。負傷しながらも、間に合わせの避難場所まで何とかはって移動し、何カ月も身を隠した。

ウラセンコさんは感情をあらわにしながら、自身の救助に向かった兵士たちが、その途中で命を落としたと語った。

そして、生き延びるために下した壮絶な決断を明かした。

「恐ろしい瞬間が何度かあった。自分で脚を切断した時もそうだ。脚が後ろに引きずられるだけになり、切断するしかなかった。引きずるたびに、骨がますますむき出しになった」

「やるしかなかった。あの脚が邪魔になっていた。もう助けようがなかった。だから切ることにした。切断して止血帯を巻き、すぐに包帯を巻いた。出血が止まったので、止血帯を緩めた。その時には、もう両脚ともなかった。両脚を失ったまま、陣地にとどまった」

今は戦闘地域を離れたウラセンコさんは、心の傷と重傷からの回復を目指している。それは戦争の中でもひときわ壮絶な体験だった。

item.title: メタに豪で集団訴訟、子どもへの有害コンテンツや依存巡り
item.description: [シドニー ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[シドニー ２２日 ロイター] - 米メタ・プラットフォームズ傘下のフェイスブックとインスタグラムが子どもを有害なコンテンツにさらし、アルゴリズムによって依存状態を持続させたとして、オーストラリアの裁判所に集団訴訟が提起された。

法律事務所ミンターエリソンが今月、オーストラリアで最高裁に次ぐ連邦裁判所に提訴した。交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）が利用者、特に子どもや１０代の若者に害を及ぼしたとして責任を問う訴訟は、同国で初めてとなる可能性がある。

・訴訟は原告８人を代表して起こされた。原告らは１８歳未満の時にメタから被害を受けたと主張し、賠償を求めている。

・メタの広報担当者は電子メールで「この訴訟については承知しており、断固として争う」と述べた。

・裁判所は１９日に出した報道禁止命令で、原告の身元が特定される可能性のある情報と訴状の内容を報じることを禁じた。

・オーストラリアでは、世界初となる１６歳未満のＳＮＳ利用禁止に加え、利用者がフィード上でアルゴリズムに基づくコンテンツ表示を無効にできるようにする新たな規則案を受け、政府と巨大ＩＴ企業の緊張が高まっている。今回の訴訟はこうした中で起こされた。

・メタは８月、子どもを依存させるようＳＮＳを設計したとの訴えを巡り、米国のほぼ全ての州と和解し、１８０億ドルを支払うことに合意した。

item.title: Typhoon Champi nears Taiwan, causing flight cancellations and disrupting US-Japan drills
item.description: Taiwan issued a land warning on Thursday as powerful Typhoon Champi approached, prompting more than 200 flight cancellations in the region and forcing changes to a major US-Japan military exercise.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Taiwan issued a land warning on Thursday as powerful Typhoon Champi approached, prompting more than 200 flight cancellations in the region and forcing changes to a major US-Japan military exercise. At one point a super typhoon and one of the strongest storms in the Pacific this year, Champi weakened slightly on Thursday but was still packing gusts of more than 227 kph (141 mph) near its centre, according to Taiwan's Central Weather Administration (CWA). The storm was about 520 km (320 miles) southeast of Taiwan's southern tip, the CWA said. The storm's track shows it will pass northeastern Taiwan, turn north toward the Chinese coast and eventually move into southern Japan. The administration said its radius expanded slightly to 320 km (199 miles), large enough to cover most of Taiwan, and weather experts said its impact could last nearly two days. Coastal towns received mobile phone alerts warning of waves exceeding 6 metres (20 feet), while nearly a metre (3 feet) of rain was forecast in northern mountain areas, including the hills near Taipei. Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te called for the public to get ready now for the typhoon, and avoid going to the mountains or the coast. "A little more preparation means less risk," he wrote on his Facebook page. Taiwan's transport ministry said 125 flights had been cancelled on Thursday, mostly domestic ones, though the rail network was so far unaffected. The interior ministry said no evacuations of residents had yet been reported. Taiwan is generally very well prepared for typhoons, which keeps casualties low. Although more common in summer, the storms can strike in autumn, bringing strong winds and torrential rain. The typhoon is also forecast to pass over Japan's westernmost inhabited island, Yonaguni, in Okinawa Prefecture. In Japan, major carriers Japan Airlines, ANA and Skymark have cancelled more than 100 flights, mostly domestic, between Thursday and Sunday, disrupting travel for over 11,000 passengers. The approaching storm is also disrupting the major military exercise called Keen Sword that is underway around Japanese islands near Taiwan. Held every two years, the exercise rehearses Japan's defence through coordinated land, sea and air operations, including missile defence drills and amphibious landings. It began on Monday, involving about 56,000 Japanese and US personnel alongside forces from five other countries, including the Philippines and Australia. "Training activities are being adjusted on a day-to-day basis to ensure the safety of all participants," the US military said.

US orders diplomats to depart Saudi Arabia amid Houthi strikes

JERUSALEM: The US State Department has ordered some diplomats and family members to depart from its missions in Saudi Arabia and plans to withdraw family members from a number of other US missions in the region, US officials told Reuters. The order came as attacks in Saudi Arabia killed at least one person and injured eight others at a civilian airport in Dammam and two people were killed in a drone attack on an oil field. State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said in a post on X that the department ordered the departure of "non-emergency US government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia only" amid attacks by the Iran-aligned Houthis in Yemen on civilian targets in the country. Washington had returned some diplomatic personnel to the region in recent months after many were pulled out when Tehran launched attacks on US facilities after the US-Israeli war on Iran began in late February.

"Iranian-supported Houthis have increasingly engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure resulting in civilian casualties and severe travel disruptions," Pigott said.

Related:

UK to deploy fighter jets to help protect Saudi from Houthi attacks

Singaporeans advised to defer all travel to Saudi Arabia amid heightened security risks: MFA

Four US officials told Reuters that US missions in other Gulf states would also be ordering family members to leave. Pigott did not address changes to other missions outside Saudi Arabia. The latest withdrawals follow an escalation of the fighting in Yemen, opening another front in the regional conflict triggered by the US-Israeli war on Iran. The wider conflict has snarled global energy trade and hurt Gulf economies. After the departure order, Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority reported an attack on King Fahd International Airport in Dammam that killed one person and injured eight others. Earlier in the day, two people were killed after Saudi air defences intercepted a drone that was attempting to hit a facility at Saudi Aramco's Shaybah oilfield, the energy ministry said. The US embassy in Riyadh issued a security alert on Wednesday (Oct 21) about possible further attacks by the Houthis on Saudi Arabia, after recent deadly strikes including on Riyadh's airport. The embassy and a CIA station hosted there came under attack by drones in early March, as Iran began launching attacks across the region.

item.title: Cloudflare sees millions of exploit attempts after PHP disclosure
item.description: Cloud services firm Cloudflare saw millions of exploitation attempts after the public disclosure of critical vulnerabilities in the widely used programming language PHP, CEO Matthew Prince said in a post on X late on Wedn
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Cloudflare sees millions of exploit attempts after PHP disclosure

The logo of digital security firm Cloudflare is displayed over a booth at the Web Summit digital trade show in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada, May 12, 2026. REUTERS/Chris Helgren

22 Oct 2026 12:10PM (Updated: 22 Oct 2026 01:21PM)

FAST

Cloud services firm Cloudflare saw millions of exploitation attempts after the public disclosure of critical vulnerabilities in the widely used programming language PHP , CEO Matthew Prince said in a post on X late on Wednesday.  "In the 10 hours before it was publicly announced, across the network we saw thousands of attempts to exploit it. That jumped to tens of thousands in the 45 minutes post announcement, hundreds of thousands within 2 hours, and millions now," Prince said.  Government websites in Europe and elsewhere went offline on Wednesday after the disclosure of vulnerabilities in PHP sent website operators around the world scrambling to protect their systems. Japanese lender Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group said it was temporarily suspending some internet services due to emergency measures.  Developers of the PHP programming language on Wednesday released urgent new fixes to vulnerabilities that had been lurking in their software for years until they were uncovered using AI, saying all users were "encouraged to update immediately." Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi also urged website owners on Wednesday to check whether their sites use PHP and prepare to apply the new fix.  Japan's Finance Ministry also temporarily suspended some website content and services while security measures were being implemented.

Source: Reuters/aj

item.title: Companies and governments rush to patch PHP flaws as hacking attempts surge into millions
item.description: Companies and governments worldwide rushed on Thursday to patch critical flaws in the widely used PHP programming language, as a cybersecurity company reported millions of hacking attempts after the vulnerabilities were disclosed.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Companies and governments worldwide rushed on Thursday to patch critical flaws in the widely used PHP programming language, as a cybersecurity company reported millions of hacking attempts after the vulnerabilities were disclosed. The push came after governments in Europe and elsewhere took websites [USN:L6N4670DM TEXT:"offline"] as a precaution on Wednesday while website operators scrambled to secure systems running the software. The emergency shutdowns of banking, airline, rail, tax and government services from Tokyo to Helsinki showed how much public and corporate systems rely on the software, and how hard it is to fix such flaws quickly once they are made public. "It was a long day and a long night, I know for all the IT and security folks ... I've not seen anything like this in a long, long time," Microsoft (MSFT.O) CEO Satya Nadella said at a company event in Cologne, Germany, on Thursday. He said the episode underscored the importance of building digital systems that can be maintained securely. PHP developers released urgent [USN:L6N4670ZW TEXT:"fixes"] on Wednesday for vulnerabilities that had lurked in the software for years until they were uncovered using AI, urging users to "update immediately". As companies and governments deployed patches and suspended websites as a precaution, hacking attempts surged into the millions, according to cloud services firm Cloudflare (NET.N) . "In the 10 hours before it was publicly announced, across the network we saw thousands of attempts to exploit it," Cloudflare CEO Matthew Prince said in a post on social media X late on Wednesday. "That jumped to tens of thousands in the 45 minutes post announcement, hundreds of thousands within 2 hours, and millions now." FROM JAPAN TO FINLAND Japanese companies including brokerage Nomura (8604.T) , lender Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (8306.T) , airline ANA (9202.T) and East Japan Railway (9020.T) said on Thursday they were temporarily suspending some internet services as part of emergency measures. Insurer Tokio Marine Holdings (8766.T) said it had suspended the website of a group company. Japan's Ministry of Finance and Meteorological Agency partially suspended online services to implement safety measures, while Japan's National Tax Agency temporarily took down its service. The precautionary shutdowns underscore growing concerns over cybersecurity in Japan, which [USN:L1N45U0IU TEXT:"recorded"] more cyber incidents in the first nine months of the year than in all of last year, according to data from TrendAI. French telecoms group Orange (ORAN.PA) said it had temporarily suspended access to certain PHP-based websites and applications across several subsidiaries as a precaution. Tencent Cloud, one of China's largest cloud-computing providers, urged customers to install updated PHP versions but stopped short of calling for widespread website shutdowns. Finland's state IT services provider Valtori said it had continued installing PHP security patches overnight and was gradually lifting precautionary service blocks after [USN:S8N3WF054 TEXT:"shutting down"] government public web services a day earlier. "Restoring services can take days or even weeks, as in addition to updates, the systems need to be carefully tested," Valtori Director General Hannu Naumanen said in a statement. Valtori said the outages were not caused by exploitation of the vulnerabilities or by a cyber breach, and that it was not aware of any active exploitation of the flaws. Several Asian governments ordered cybersecurity inspections related to the PHP vulnerabilities on Thursday. China's industry ministry urged organizations and users to inspect systems immediately and upgrade to the latest secure version of PHP. It also recommended strengthening cybersecurity monitoring and changing accounts, passwords and keys where necessary. South Korea raised its private-sector cybersecurity alert level and activated emergency response measures, citing concerns over an increased risk of hacking attacks.

Oct 22 : Strong demand for electrified cars helped Europe's new-car market grow in September, offsetting another sharp decline in petrol and diesel vehicle sales, data from the European Automobile Manufacturers' Association showed on Thursday. New-car registrations, a proxy for sales, rose 10.2 per cent year-on-year to 1.36 million vehicles across the European Union, Britain and the European Free Trade Association, ACEA said. Demand for electrified vehicles remained strong across major European markets, supported by purchase incentives and a broader model lineup. • Battery-electric, plug-in hybrid and hybrid car registrations jumped 59.9 per cent, 24 per cent and 5.3 per cent, respectively, and together accounted for 76.2 per cent of all new vehicles

item.title: アンソロピック、独立型ＡＩエージェント「デュエット」発表
item.description: [２１日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックは、専門職や小規模事業者向けの能動的アシスタントとして機能...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
アンソロピック、独立型ＡＩエージェント「デュエット」発表 13:05 配信

アンソロピックのロゴ。10月19日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２１日 ロイター] - 人工知能（ＡＩ）企業アンソロピックは、専門職や小規模事業者向けの能動的アシスタントとして機能する独立型ＡＩエージェントアプリ「クロード・デュエット」を発表した。

オープンＡＩやメタ・プラットフォームズなどの競合各社が、利用者に代わって自律的に業務を遂行するＡＩエージェントの開発を競っている。

• アンソロピックによると、デュエットは毎日、重要事項をまとめて報告するほか、会議の日程調整から財務予測やウェブアプリの作成まで幅広い業務を処理する。

• 利用待ちリストへの登録が必要な研究プレビュー版として、ｉＯＳ、アンドロイド、ｃｌａｕｄｅ．ａｉで利用できる。利用者が連携させたアプリを確認し、指示を待つのではなく、対応が必要な項目を知らせる。

• アンソロピックのＡＩモデル「Ｏｐｕｓ（オーパス）５．５」を基盤とし、当初は米国の「Ｐｒｏ」と「Ｍａｘ」プランの契約者を対象に提供する。利用上限は既存サービスと共通となる。

•  オープンＡＩは９月、スラックやマイクロソフトの「チームズ」など複数のアプリを横断し、利用者の目標達成に向けて動く常時稼働型エージェント「ｄｏｔｓ（ドッツ）」を投入した。一方、メタのＡＩエージェント「ミューズ」はダウンロード数が数百万件に達し、自律型ＡＩサービスに対する投資家の関心を高めた。

• デュエットは「クロード・マーケットプレイス」にあるＧメールやスラックなど６０００超の連携機能に対応する。ストライプのデジタルウォレット「Ｌｉｎｋ」やショッピファイの「Ｓｈｏｐ　Ｐａｙ」を使った購入も可能だ。

•  アンソロピックは、慎重な扱いを要する操作には利用者の承認が必要だと説明した。また、緊急性を誤って判断する場合があり、チケットの予約など個人的なタスクでは依然として効果が限定的だを認めた。

item.title: Gold hits over two-week low as oil rally fuels inflation worries
item.description: Gold slipped to its lowest level in more than two weeks on Thursday as a rally in oil prices heightened inflation worries, with the Federal Reserve due to deliver its policy decision next week.
item.dc:creator: Vishak Mathew
item.content:encoded: Gold slipped to its lowest level in more than two weeks on Thursday as a rally in oil prices heightened inflation worries, with the Federal Reserve due to deliver its policy decision next week. Spot gold slid 1.4% to $4,081.89 per ounce by 0902 GMT. US gold futures for December delivery fell 1.3% to $4,097.90 per ounce. "Gold prices can fall further... because we are still seeing a lot of uncertainty around the energy market," said Soni Kumari, analyst at ANZ. Oil prices rallied over $2 a barrel on Thursday after more Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia stoked concerns over a broader escalation of conflict and further disruptions to crude supplies. While gold is typically considered a hedge against inflation, higher interest rates reduce the appeal of the non-yielding asset. Last week's US [USN:L1N45Z121 TEXT:"consumer"] and [USN:L1N4610KT TEXT:"producer"] inflation data came in hotter than expected, largely because energy costs keep climbing. That strengthens the case for tighter policy, even though Fed officials are still expected to [USN:L6N46606V TEXT:"hold off"] when they meet on October 27-28. Goldman Sachs expects one more 25-basis-point hike in December, lifting the peak policy rate range to 4.00%-4.25%. Traders are pricing in a 91% likelihood of an increase in December, according to CME's FedWatch Tool . US Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) data, set for release on October 29 and closely watched by the central bank, could give more clues on rate outlook. "Given that the PCE data will show that prices rose at an uncomfortably high pace for the Fed, the FOMC communications may strike a hawkish tone and that could weigh on gold prices," Hamad Hussain, climate and commodities economist at Capital Economics, said. Among other metals, spot silver dropped 3.7% to $55.86 per ounce, platinum slid 2.6% to $1,586.22, its lowest since July 2026, while palladium fell 3.2% to $1,052.88 after hitting its lowest level since June 2025.

item.title: ＰＨＰ脆弱性で対応急ぐ企業、政府機関も影響 官房長官「状況注視」
item.description: ［東京 ２２日 ロイター］ - ウェブサイトの動作に使われるプログラミング言語ＰＨＰの深刻な脆弱性が公表されたことを受け...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＰＨＰ脆弱性で対応急ぐ企業、政府機関も影響　官房長官「状況注視」 12:37 配信

コンピューターサーバーのケーブル。ベルリンで10月21日撮影。REUTERS/Annegret Hilse

［東京　２２日　ロイター］ - ウェブサイトの動作に使われるプログラミング言語ＰＨＰの深刻な脆弱性が公表されたことを受け、日本国内でも金融機関などの企業や自治体、政府機関などに影響が広がっている。木原稔官房長官は２２日午前の会見で「現時点で関係する被害の報告は受けていない」と明らかにすると同時に、企業などに修正パッチの適用を勧めており、政府として状況を注視し、対応していく考えを示した。

＜企業などへの影響＞

三菱ＵＦＪ銀行は三菱ＵＦＪダイレクトやスマート口座開設アプリなどによる投資信託口座開設やＮＩＳＡ利用申し込みなどを一時停止。日本生命は安全性確認のための予防的システム対応として、一部サイトやサービスを一時停止した。三井ＤＳアセットマネジメントでも、対象サービスを一時停止している。滋賀銀行もサーバーメンテナンスを実施しており、ホームページにアクセスできない状況となっている。

ＪＲ西日本は臨時のシステムメンテナンスで一部ＷＥＢページなどの利用を停止。福岡県はホームページの一部機能を停止している。

ウェブ技術調査会社Ｗ３Ｔｅｃｈｓによると、プログラミング言語を特定できるウェブサイトのうち約７５％でＰＨＰが使われている。

＜政府機関＞

木原官房長官によると、厚生労働省と財務省などが一部のコンテンツについて予防のために一時的に公開の停止措置を講じている。

＜政府対応＞

高市早苗首相は２１日夜、Ｘへの投稿で、運用中のサイトがＰＨＰを使用しているか確認し、新たな修正プログラムを適用できるよう準備してほしいとサイト運営者に呼びかけた。木原官房長官によると、政府は国家サイバー統括室を中心に政府関連機関や重要インフラ事業者などに幅広く修正パッチ適用の注意喚起行った。

＜市場＞

株式市場では一部米半導体製造装置メーカーの下落を受け、半導体関連を中心に売られ、全体相場が下落するなか、関連銘柄を物色する動きが活発化。サイバーセキュリティクラウドやトレンドマイクロなど、セキュリティ関連株が上昇した。

外国為替市場や円債市場に大きな動きはみられていない。

item.description:
Atsuko Aoyama
[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 午前のドルは１５７円後半へ軟化した。米金利が低下してドル...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前のドルは157円後半へ軟化、米金利が低下　レンジ推移は継続 12:31 配信

日本の1万円紙幣。10月20日撮影。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon

Atsuko Aoyama

[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 午前のドルは１５７円後半へ軟化した。米金利が低下してドル売りに傾いた。ここ最近のレンジの範囲内での推移は変わらず、日米中銀の金融政策決定会合や米中間選挙を前に様子見ムードも強いとの声がある。

・ドル１５８円前半から一時１５７．６８円まで下落

・米長期金利低下、５．１％台から５．０８％付近に

・ユーロ／ドル、前日の高値を上抜け１．１２５５ドル付近まで上昇

・ドル１５７円後半から１５８円半ばのレンジ推移は続く

・日米中銀会合や米中間選挙待ち、積極的な売買手控え

・２００日移動平均線突破できず、上値の重さ意識

＜みなと銀行資金証券部ストラテジストの苅谷将吾氏＞

「２０日に２００日移動平均線を突破できず、上値の重さが意識されている」

「来週の中銀会合を控える中で手掛かりなく、積極的な売買は手控えられている」

「日銀が基調的物価上昇率について２％程度に到達したと判断するかは注目」

「実需勢は為替予約を済ませている参加者も多く、レンジをブレイクしないと実需勢も出てきづらい」

item.description: [東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 酒類・食品大手の宝ホールディングスの筆頭株主である米投資会社のバリューアクト・キャピ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米バリューアクト、宝ＨＤに臨時株主総会の招集請求　社外取3人の解任提案 12:11 配信

バリューアクト・キャピタルのロバート・ヘイル共同ＣＥＯ。ニューヨークで10月20日撮影。REUTERS/Brendan McDermid

[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 酒類・食品大手の宝ホールディングスの筆頭株主である米投資会社のバリューアクト・キャピタルは２２日、宝ＨＤに対して臨時株主総会の招集を正式に請求したと発表した。長年にわたる業績不振と取締役会による経営陣監督の不備を理由に、社外取締役について現職３人の解任と新たな３人の選任を提案している。

請求を受け宝ＨＤは、内容を慎重に検討した上で対応方針を決め次第、速やかに開示するとしている。

バリューアクトは宝ＨＤの株式を買い進め、現在約２０．０％を保有する。６年以上にわたり戦略の見直しや実行力改善を非公開の場で求めてきたが、取締役会が実質的な対話に応じなかったとして、株主権の行使に踏み切った。

宝ＨＤを巡っては、香港投資ファンドのオアシス・マネジメントも５．０９％の株式を保有していることが大量保有報告書で明らかになっている。

item.title: 米テキサス・インスツルメンツ、第4四半期売上高見通しが予想超え
item.description: [２１日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手テキサス・インスツルメンツ（ＴＩ）は２１日、第４・四半期の売上高が５８億―６３...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米テキサス・インスツルメンツ、第4四半期売上高見通しが予想超え 12:06 配信

テキサス・インスツルメンツのロゴとコンピューターのマザーボードのイメージ。２０２５年８月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

[２１日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手テキサス・インスツルメンツ（ＴＩ）は２１日、第４・四半期の売上高が５８億―６３億ドルになるとの見通しを発表した。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想平均の５７億３０００万ドルを上回る予想。産業用半導体需要の回復と、同社の人工知能（ＡＩ）データセンター向け半導体販売の勢い増加を示している。

第４・四半期の１株当たり利益は２．４５―２．７９ドルとなる見通し。

同時に発表した第３・四半期の売上高は前年同期比２８％増の６０億６０００万と、予想の５９億２０００万ドルを超えた。１株当たり利益は７７％増の２．６２ドルだった。

高性能ＡＩプロセッサを手がける米エヌビディア と異なり、ＴＩは電力を管理し、音、光、温度などの現実世界の入力を他の半導体が処理できるようにデジタル信号へ変換するアナログチップを製造。スマートフォン、ノートパソコン、自動車、工場設備などで使用されている。

item.title: Rupee snaps eight-day rally as oil climbs to highest since May
item.description: The Indian rupee snapped an eight-session-long winning streak on Thursday as Brent oil prices climbed to their highest since May on deepening worries about conflict in the Middle East, which hammered global equities as well.
item.dc:creator: Jaspreet Kalra
item.content:encoded: The Indian rupee snapped an eight-session-long winning streak on Thursday as Brent oil prices climbed to their highest since May on deepening worries about conflict in the Middle East, which hammered global equities as well. The South Asian currency endured a volatile trading session, swinging from its strongest level in over six weeks to close down 0.4% at 94.8175 per dollar. Earlier in the day, chunky foreign inflows for Jio Platforms' IPO added to tailwinds from the Reserve Bank of India's defensive measures that had boosted the currency but its gains faded as oil prices climbed in the latter half. Traders pointed to broad-based dollar demand locally alongside broader signs of a risk-off move in global markets. MSCI's All-World index (.MIWD00000PUS) was set for its largest daily fall in two weeks, down 0.4%, as tech shares from Seoul and Tokyo to Amsterdam and Paris came under pressure. Equity futures pointed to a weak start for shares on Wall Street as well. OIL PRICES REMAIN A KEY RISK Oil prices have remained elevated despite oil flows from the Gulf holding up, reflecting market anxieties over the conflict. "The sizeable risk premium currently embedded in prices is unlikely to fade until clear signs of de-escalation emerge and reassure investors that regional supply will remain uninterrupted," ING said in a note. Brent oil prices were last up 3.3% at $112.40 per barrel. India imports nearly 90% of its crude requirements, making it one of the world's most vulnerable economies to the Middle East oil shock. This remains a key risk for the rupee, with market participants and observers split over how sternly the RBI should defend the currency in the face of fundamental pressures. While senior IMF official Krishna Srinivasan [USN:L4N4670Q1 TEXT:"said"] on Wednesday that India should allow the dollar-rupee exchange rate to move as the first line of defence, former RBI deputy governor Michael Debabrata Patra [USN:L4N4680AC TEXT:"told Reuters"] that exchange rates tend to overshoot and can cause financial stability risks.

item.title: 午前の日経平均は反落、6万4000円割れ ＡＩ・半導体株に売り
item.description:
Hiroko Hamada
[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比１．０９％...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
午前の日経平均は反落、6万4000円割れ　ＡＩ・半導体株に売り 11:55 配信

東京証券取引所。２０１５年６月、都内で撮影。REUTERS/Thomas Peter

Hiroko Hamada

[東京 ２２日 ロイター] - 前場の東京株式市場で日経平均は反落し、前営業日比１．０９％（７０３円８１銭）安の６万３９１７円４３銭となった。米半導体製造装置メーカーのラム・リサーチ株が決算発表後の時間外で下落したことを受けて、ＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連株が売られ、相場の重しとなった。前場終盤には下げ幅を拡大し、節目の６万４０００円を割り込んだ。

・日経平均は前営業日比０．１３％安でスタートした後、プラス転換したが、再びマイナス圏に沈んだ。

・２２日朝に公表されたラムリサーチの決算を受けて、同社株は時間外取引で下落。東京市場でも半導体関連株を中心に売りが強まる。個別では、東京エレクトロン、アドバンテストなど寄与度の高い銘柄が軟調。

・日経平均は前場終盤に１．１４％（７３８円）安の６万３８８２円７７銭まで下落。ＴＯＰＩＸは小幅安。

・物色面では、サイバーセキュリティ関連株が大幅高。ウェブサイトの動作に使われるプログラミング言語ＰＨＰの深刻な脆弱性が公表されたことを受け、思惑買いが広がった。

・ＴＯＰＩＸは０．２８％安の４０３２．２２ポイントで午前の取引を終了。東証プライム市場の売買代金は３兆１１９１億９３００万円。

・東証３３業種では、保険、サービス、鉱業など２０業種が値上がり。非鉄金属、ガラス・土石製品、銀行など１３業種が値下がりした。

・東証プライム市場の騰落数は、値上がりが７７６銘柄（５０％）、値下がりは７２１銘柄（４６％）、変わらずは５５銘柄（３％）。

＜東海東京インテリジェンス・ラボ　シニアアナリスト　澤田遼太郎氏＞

「足元のマーケットは弱気に傾いており、半導体関連株はネガティブな材料に大きく反応しやすくなっている。一番の支えは決算の期待感だが、相場のムードが弱気な上、投資家の期待も高く、決算が良くても素直に買われるかは不透明」

「ＰＨＰの脆弱性の問題は、今のところ株式市場全体を押し下げるほどのネガティブな材料にはなっていないとみる。ただ、一部企業ではサービスを停止する事態となり、上値を抑える要因として意識されているのではないか」

item.title: Indian shares extend losses as high oil prices heighten inflation worries
item.description: Indian shares fell for a third straight session on Thursday, as an escalating Middle East war pushed oil prices higher to $112 per barrel, stoking inflation concerns for the world's third-largest importer of crude.
item.dc:creator: Bharath Rajeswaran, Vivek M
item.content:encoded: Indian shares fell for a third straight session on Thursday, as an escalating Middle East war pushed oil prices higher to $112 per barrel, stoking inflation concerns for the world's third-largest importer of crude. The benchmark Nifty 50 (.NSEI) fell 0.54% to 22,687.65, and the Sensex (.BSESN) shed 0.62% to 73,249.39. The broader small-caps (.NIFSMCP100) and mid-caps (.NIFMDCP100) dropped 1.1% and 0.9%, respectively. Other Asian markets also slumped to near three-month lows, after more Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia intensified concerns over broader escalation of conflict and fears of supply disruptions. The attacks prompted the US to order some diplomats and family members to leave its missions in the kingdom. "Higher crude prices remains the key overhang for markets as they heighten price pressures in the economy, besides potentially weighing on corporate profit margins," said Sanjeeb Hota, director, head of strategy of equities at Standard Chartered India. "It should also be noted that markets had logged strong gains last week and this could just be profit taking, rather than any adverse view on earnings," Hota said. Thirteen of the 16 major sectors logged losses, with IT (.NIFTYIT) , energy (.NIFTYENR) and FMCG (.NIFTYFMCG) losing the most percentage-wise. Heavyweight stocks on the benchmarks, HDFC Bank (HDBK.NS) and Reliance Industries (RELI.NS) , fell 1.8% and 2%, respectively. Mahindra & Mahindra Financial Services (MMFS.NS) slid 3.3%, with multiple brokerages flagging mounting funding costs and risks from insurance distribution reforms. Nestle India (NEST.NS) dipped 2.8%, Abbott India (ABOT.NS) dropped 1.3% and Zydus Wellness (ZYDS.NS) declined 3.4% after receiving notices from India's food safety regulator. Abbott said it was not aware of the social media content cited by the regulator until receiving the notice, and that it did not endorse the claims. Nestle said the notice reiterated earlier label-related concerns to which it had submitted a detailed response. Zydus Wellness did not respond to Reuters' request for comment. Cybersecurity firm eMudhra (EMUD.NS) slid 20%, taking its two-session losses to 36%, after the Indian Computer Emergency Response Team issued an advisory stating that some of eMudhra's intermediate certificates were compromised.

FAST

LONDON, Oct 22 : Global stocks retreated on Thursday, as tech earnings' optimism provided only fleeting support and was offset by nagging concern over the outlook for AI, while stalemate in the Gulf pushed up oil prices. MSCI's All-World index was set for its largest daily fall in two weeks, down 0.4 per cent, as tech shares from Seoul and Tokyo to Amsterdam and Paris tumbled.  Meta, the first of the so-called AI hyperscalers to publish quarterly results, reported third-quarter revenue late on Wednesday that beat expectations. But any optimism was short-lived, after the company unveiled a plan to issue non-voting stock that revived concern over its mounting capital commitments. "There are lots of cross currents in markets at the moment, which are grappling for a narrative right now," Ben Laidler, head of macro and equity strategy at Bradesco BBI, said.

"The big concern is that AI-driven earnings narrative, which has supported US earnings and spread to global equities, may be challenged here." Meta also suffered a legal blow overnight, after a judge in New Mexico ordered the company to pay a $25 billion penalty to the state in a data privacy case. In Europe, the STOXX 600 fell 1 per cent, weighed down by tech-related stocks such as ASML, Schneider Electric and Siemens Energy. US stock futures fell between 1 per cent and 2 per cent, suggesting a drop at the open bell later. Shares in Meta fell around 0.8 per cent and those in Tesla, which also reported earnings and cut its spending forecast ahead of a possible merger with SpaceX, dropped nearly 5 per cent in the premarket. Geopolitical concerns played out in oil markets, where Brent crude rose 3 per cent to $112 a barrel, near a five-month high, after more Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia raised the risk of wider conflict and supply disruptions in the Middle East. There was enough nervousness about the possible damage to the global economy to offset concern about a sustained pickup in inflation to drive flows into government bonds, which pushed US Treasury yields down by the most in a week. The 10-year note was last 7 basis points lower at 5.075 per cent, trading below that of France for the first time in 13 years. French government bonds have been battered this month, driving yields above 5 per cent for the first time since 2002, as investors looked for signs the government can contain social unrest and bring spending under control. The euro, which has been dragged 0.8 per cent lower this month, was steady on Thursday, trading around $1.1241, leaving the dollar index, which tracks the US currency against a basket of six others, down 0.1 per cent.  The yen drew safe-haven demand, leaving the dollar down 0.7 per cent on the day at 157.1, after Deputy Bank of Japan Governor Ryozo Himino signalled his readiness to raise borrowing costs. The Korean won was muted at 1324, after the Bank of Korea left its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 3.00 per cent on Thursday. Gold missed out on safe-haven flows, dropping 1.2 per cent to $4,090 an ounce, while in cryptocurrencies, bitcoin and ether both lost 3 per cent to trade at $82,000 and $2,412, respectively.  (Additional reporting by Jiaxing Li in Hong Kong; Editing by Kate Mayberry, Shri Navaratnam and Susan Fenton)

Türkiye, Qatar, Pakistan, Indonesia sign defence cooperation accord, Ankara says

Turkey, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia signed an agreement on Wednesday to boost defence cooperation and strengthen defensive capabilities in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia on Oct 5, 2026. (Photo: Reuters/Saudi Press Agency)

FAST

ANKARA: Türkiye, Qatar, Pakistan, and Indonesia signed an agreement on Wednesday (Oct 21) to boost defence cooperation and strengthen defensive capabilities, the Turkish Defence Ministry said. In a statement, the ministry said the countries signed the Badr Memorandum of Understanding in Doha as a sign of their desire to further deepen cooperation and develop partnerships. "The agreement holds substantial economic importance," it said, adding the accord sought to foster cooperation in military production, boost military capabilities, and help collaboration in technical military training, research and development. "By leveraging the unique military production capabilities of each country, the initiative will facilitate cooperation and integration, enhance defence industrial capacities, and enable the fulfilment of the needs of allied and friendly nations," it added.

Türkiye, which has NATO's second-largest army and a robust defence industry, has been helping Gulf nations, including Qatar, where it has a military base, bolster their defences amid the Iran war. In August, it signed a mutual defence pact with nuclear-armed Pakistan and Saudi Arabia, under which an attack on one party constitutes an attack on all. Ankara also has close ties with Indonesia, notably in the defence industry. The ministry said the Badr accord would strengthen ties between the countries' defence industries and bolster collaboration to promote security and achieve shared objectives. Haluk Gorgun, the chairman of Türkiye's Defence Industry Presidency, said the accord formed the foundation of a "strategic cooperation" to develop joint production and technology. "Technology sharing, joint development and strengthening domestic production capabilities lie at the heart of sustainable defence industry. As Türkiye, we value partnerships that go beyond off-the-shelf procurement models, that foster the development of a nation’s own human capital and industrial infrastructure," Gorgun said in a statement. "We believe that the Badr Memorandum of Understanding will contribute to transforming the complementary capabilities of Qatar, Pakistan, Indonesia, and Türkiye into concrete projects," he added.

item.title: インド中銀、追加利上げ示唆 積極引き締めには慎重＝議事要旨
item.description: [ムンバイ ２１日 ロイター] - インド準備銀行（ＲＢＩ、中央銀行）は２１日、７日に開いた金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）の議...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インド中銀、追加利上げ示唆　積極引き締めには慎重＝議事要旨 11:07 配信

ムンバイにあるインド準備銀行（RBI）本部で8月撮影。 REUTERS/Francis Mascarenhas

[ムンバイ ２１日 ロイター] - インド準備銀行（ＲＢＩ、中央銀行）は２１日、７日に開いた金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）の議事要旨を公表した。それによると、委員らはインフレ抑制のために追加利上げが必要になる可能性を示唆した一方、経済成長へのリスクを踏まえ、積極的な金融引き締めサイクルを支持するまでには至らなかった。

ＲＢＩは７日、主要政策金利であるレポ金利を全会一致で２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げ、５．５０％とした。利上げは約４年ぶり。金融政策のスタンスは「中立」から「調整された引き締め」へ変更した。マルホトラ総裁はこの変更は実質的に利下げの可能性がなくなったことを示していると述べた。

インドでは中東戦争による原油価格の急騰やモンスーン降雨量の不足を受けて食品価格が上昇し、インフレ懸念が強まっている。このため市場では、今後１２カ月間で１００ｂｐ強の利上げが織り込まれている。

マルホトラ総裁は議事要旨で「インフレが幅広い分野に広がりつつある兆候が強まっている」と指摘した。

インドの９月の消費者物価上昇率（ＣＰＩ）は５．５４％と、市場予想を上回る伸びとなり、中銀の許容上限である６％に近づいた。これにより追加利上げの必要性が強まっている。

中銀は最新の見通しで、１０－１２月期の平均インフレ率が６％になると予測している。

グプタ副総裁はこうした状況を踏まえ「インフレの広がりを示す、より決定的な証拠を待つよりも、金融政策の効果には時間差があることを意識すべきだ」と主張。「インフレ率を低水準に抑え、インフレ期待を安定させるためには、政策金利のさらなる引き上げが必要になる可能性がある」と述べた。

ＭＰＣ委員のサウガタ・バタチャリヤ氏は議事要旨で「あらゆる情報を総括すると、現時点では金融政策を引き締める強い経済的根拠がある」と指摘し、「あまりに急速な政策金利の調整は、成長を抑制するリスクがある」と付け加えた。

ただ最終的にどの程度の金融引き締めが必要になるかについては、委員やエコノミストの間で見方が分かれている。

ＭＰＣ委員のナゲシュ・クマール氏とラム・シン氏はともに、金融政策スタンスの変更に反対した。シン氏は特に、この変更が長期にわたる利上げサイクルを示唆する可能性があるが、現時点ではその必要性はないと主張した。

シン氏は議事要旨で「現段階では、長期にわたる利上げサイクルの継続ではなく、小幅かつ段階的なレポ金利の引き上げが妥当だ」と指摘。積極的な金融引き締めの見通しは、金利に敏感な分野にとどまらず、需要全体を弱める可能性があると述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：何が豪ドルを動かしているのか＝高島修氏 コラム：円急伸で揺らぐキャリートレード、見つからない次の調達通貨 アングル：ＥＣＢ、金利据え置きへ　原油価格が再び焦点 コラム：ウォーシュＦＲＢ議長が問う見通しのあり方、3つの論点＝井上哲也氏 アングル：世界的な中銀の金融引き締め姿勢、米イラン合意でも潮目変わらず 最終更新: 10/22(木) 11:07 ロイター

item.title: テスラ、サイバーキャブの年内販売目指す 米当局は調査継続
item.description:
Abhirup Roy
[サンフランシスコ ２１日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラは２１日、ロボタクシ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
テスラ、サイバーキャブの年内販売目指す　米当局は調査継続 10:56 配信

イーロン・マスク氏のイメージとテスラのロゴ。6月撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Abhirup Roy

[サンフランシスコ ２１日 ロイター] - 米電気自動車（ＥＶ）大手テスラは２１日、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」の一般向け販売を年末までに開始することを目指していると明らかにした。同車には連邦規則が通常義務付けている手動操作装置がなく、米自動車安全当局が調査を進めている。

サイバーキャブは金色の２人乗り車両で、バタフライドアを備え、ハンドルやペダル、ミラーなしで自動走行する。

車両技術担当副社長のラース・モラビー氏は、第３・四半期決算発表後のアナリスト向け説明会で「テスラの成長に伴い、顧客に提供する車両は、自動運転専用に設計されたものが中心になる。サイバーキャブがその第１弾となる」と述べた。

「２０２６年末までにサイバーキャブを顧客に届けようとしている」とし、「今年は小規模にスタートし、顧客の手に渡る自動運転車の納車や保有、車両群の管理について学びながら規模を拡大していく」と語った。

テスラは９月上旬、テキサス州オースティンで少数のサイバーキャブによる有料乗車サービスを開始。しかし、その直後、米道路交通安全局（ＮＨＴＳＡ）は、同社がサイバーキャブについて連邦の自動車安全規則に適合すると判断した根拠を調べるため、調査を開始したと発表した。

大半の国では新型車や新技術の投入前に規制当局の承認が必要だが、米国では自動車メーカーが連邦基準への適合を自己認証すれば、公道に投入できる。

ＮＨＴＳＡはコメントを控えた。同局は９月、テスラによるサイバーキャブ認証の根拠と、どの範囲の基準について同車に適用されないと判断したのかを調べていると説明した。同社の回答期限は１０月３０日となっている。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：減速するテスラ、頼みの綱は国内ライバル勢の出遅れ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 アングル：ロボタクシー拡大に慎重になったテスラ　投資家の不満解消できるか アングル：テスラのロボタクシー、導入済みテキサス3都市では課題山積 アングル：テスラの納車台数、26年予想下振れ　3年連続減少の見方も 最終更新: 10/22(木) 10:56 ロイター

item.title: 欧州新興企業、域外に大量流出リスク 規制など制約多く＝ＡＷＳ幹部
item.description:
Mehnaz Yasmin Deborah Mary Sophia
[２１日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コム...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州新興企業、域外に大量流出リスク　規制など制約多く＝ＡＷＳ幹部 10:44 配信

米アマゾン・ドット・コムのクラウドサービス部門ＡＷＳのロゴ。2024年4月、独ハノーバーで撮影。 REUTERS/Annegret Hilse

Mehnaz Yasmin　Deborah Mary Sophia

[２１日 ロイター] - 米アマゾン・ドット・コムのクラウドサービス部門ＡＷＳの幹部は２１日、ロイターのインタビューで、欧州の有望なスタートアップ企業が域外に大量流出するリスクが高まっていると警告した。規制上の障壁や資金不足、人材のスキル不足を背景に、これらの企業は域外への移転を検討しているという。

欧州は人工知能（ＡＩ）分野で米国や中国との差を縮めるのに苦戦。厳格な規制に加え、エネルギー制約やデータプライバシーへの懸念が足かせとなっており、最先端のＡＩモデルを独自に生み出した例は少ない。現在はオープンＡＩやアンソロピックなど海外企業への依存が続いている。

こうした中でＡＷＳの欧州・中東・アフリカ（ＥＭＥＡ）地域担当マネジングディレクター、タヌジャ・ランデリー氏は「欧州企業は１ユーロを投じるごとに最大０．４０ユーロを規制対応に費やしており、その分を技術投資に回せていないと話している」と述べた。

またＡＷＳが実施した調査を引用して「欧州のスタートアップのおよそ１０社に４社が、事業拡大のため域外への移転を検討している。急成長企業に限れば、その割合は半数を超える。スタートアップ企業は十分な資金や支援を得られないことから、拠点の見直しを進めていると訴えている」と語った。

ランデリー氏によると、欧州企業の半数超がＡＩを活用している一方、明確なＡＩ戦略を持ち、ＡＩガバナンス体制を整備し、業務変革に向けた投資を進めている企業は５社に１社にとどまる。特に推論分野への投資を進める必要があるという。

欧州では世界で最も厳しいＡＩ規制の１つとされる欧州連合（ＥＵ）のＡＩ法や、深刻な電力・送電網制約が発展の妨げとなっている。

ランデリー氏は「欧州はより迅速に行動する必要がある。安全性と進歩は二者択一ではなく、両立できるものだ」と強調した。

ロイター 関連ニュース コラム：ＥＵのＥＶ補助金巡る対中調査、自らに跳ね返るリスクも コラム：短距離フライト削減でＣＯ2対策なるか、的外れの欧州 焦点：トランプ政権の影で歩み寄るカナダとＥＵ、準加盟提示でも見える限界 焦点：コーヒー企業「アフリカ離れ」も、ＥＵが森林破壊防止法 アングル：長時間労働・残業に不満の中国労働者、ＥＵの対中圧力に「共感」 最終更新: 10/22(木) 10:44 ロイター

item.title: Epic's 'Fortnite' back on Apple App Store in Australia after antitrust ruling
item.description: Epic Games said its shooter title "Fortnite" will return to Apple's App Store in Australia on Thursday after a federal court ordered the iPhone maker to open up its iOS operating system, having found it violated competition law.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Epic Games said its shooter title "Fortnite" will return to Apple's (AAPL.O) App Store in Australia on Thursday after a federal court ordered the iPhone maker to open up its iOS operating system, having found it violated competition law. Apple said it disagreed with many of the court's findings and would seek to challenge them. "We will request a stay and appeal the outcome to seek a resolution that respects our intellectual property and protects the safe, secure experience that consumers and developers expect from the App Store," an Apple spokesperson told Reuters.

item.title: Tesla aims to sell Cybercab robotaxis by end of year despite federal probe
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 21 : Tesla is aiming to start selling its Cybercab robotaxis to the public by the end of this year, its engineering chief said on Wednesday, even as the US auto safety agency probes the vehicles that come without manual controls which federal regulations typically require. The gold, two-s

Tesla aims to sell Cybercab robotaxis by end of year despite federal probe

A black Tesla Robotaxi parked outside of a hotel ahead of an event in Austin, Texas, U.S. September 3, 2026. REUTERS/Kaylee Greenlee

22 Oct 2026 09:36AM

FAST

SAN FRANCISCO, Oct 21 : Tesla is aiming to start selling its Cybercab robotaxis to the public by the end of this year, its engineering chief said on Wednesday, even as the US auto safety agency probes the vehicles that come without manual controls which federal regulations typically require.  The gold, two-seaters – that come with butterfly doors and drive themselves without any steering wheel, pedals or mirrors – are one of the key bets CEO Elon Musk has made in his ambition of turning the EV maker into an AI and robotics company. "As Tesla grows, we'll mainly deliver fully designed autonomous vehicles to our customers and Cybercabs will be the first," Lars Moravy, Tesla's vice president of vehicle engineering, told analysts after reporting third-quarter results. "We're trying to get Cybercabs to customers by the end of this year, 2026," he said. "As we start small this year, and we learn ... about delivery and ownership and fleet management of autonomous vehicles in customer hands, we'll continue to scale that."

After years of missed promises by Musk, Tesla started offering paid rides on a small fleet of Cybercabs in Austin, Texas, early last month amid a frenzy of fans and social media influencers.  Just hours later, the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) said it opened an investigation into Cybercabs to assess how Tesla determined the cars comply with federal vehicle-safety regulations. Those regulations, written decades ago for human-driven vehicles, require manual controls and limit commercial deployment of vehicles that are designed without them.  Unlike most other countries, where new vehicle models and technology need regulatory clearance ahead of launch, automakers in the US can deploy them on the public roads by self-certifying that they meet federal standards. NHTSA declined to comment. The agency last month said it was looking into the basis of Tesla's certification of the Cybercab and the extent to which the company determined that certain standards were not applicable to the vehicle. Tesla has until October 30 to respond to the agency.  NHTSA has proposed changes to federal safety standards to allow AVs that are designed without human controls. Until those changes are complete, existing standards remain in force, NHTSA has said.     SCALING THE CYBERCAB "I think the key thing which we are trying to make sure is that we have all the regulatory approvals where we can start deploying the Cybercabs as fast as we can produce them," Ashok Elluswamy, Tesla's head of AI, said on the call. That aside, "scaling would not be that much of a challenge," he said, adding that the Cybercab was "one of the easiest products" to scale in terms of manufacturing. The Cybercab is part of Tesla's robotaxi network that includes autonomous Model Ys, some with human safety monitors. Over time, Tesla intends to make the Cybercab the main driverless vehicle model operating within a larger robotaxi network. Tesla plans to expand the Cybercab service to Dallas next month, Elluswamy said.  The vehicle, however, will mainly be Tesla owned and used for its ride-hailing service, Musk said.

Source: Reuters

item.description:
Cynthia Kim
[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国銀行（中央銀行）は２２日、政策金利を３．００％に据え置い...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
韓国中銀、政策金利据え置き　成長見通し改善で利上げ示唆 10:08 配信

ソウルにある韓国銀行。２０１６年３月撮影。 REUTERS/Kim Hong-Ji

Cynthia Kim

[ソウル ２２日 ロイター] - 韓国銀行（中央銀行）は２２日、政策金利を３．００％に据え置いた。７月と８月にそれぞれ０．２５％ポイントの利上げを実施した後、利上げを休止した。ただ、経済成長見通しを引き上げ、輸出の勢いについても楽観的な見方を維持し、タカ派姿勢を堅持した。

７人で構成する金融政策委員会は、７日物レポ金利を３．００％に維持することを決めた。ロイター調査ではアナリスト３４人全員が据え置きを予想していた。

中銀は、インフレや金融の安定、国内経済の動向を見極めながら「今後の利上げの時期とペースを判断する」とし、追加引き締めの可能性を引き続き残した。

声明で「今年と来年の成長率は、８月時点の予測であるそれぞれ３．３％と２．９％を大幅に上回る見通しだ」と表明。今回の据え置き決定は、対外リスクのほか、７月と８月の連続利上げが時間差で及ぼす影響を見極めるために必要だったと説明した。

来年の総合インフレ率とコアインフレ率は従来予測を上回るとの見通しも示した。

＜次回利上げ、柔軟に判断＞

申鉉松総裁は記者会見で、政策金利の最終到達点に関する質問にはコメントを控え、「（市場のコンセンサス予想が示す）道筋に厳密に従う必要があるとは考えていない」と述べた。

あらかじめ決めた道筋に固執するのではなく、新たなデータをその都度評価していく方針を示し、「われわれ自身の考えを精緻化し、引き続き柔軟な姿勢で金融政策を運営する」と語った。

アナリストのコンセンサス予想では、１１月と２０２７年第１・四半期にそれぞれ追加利上げが実施され、政策金利は３．５０％でピークに達する見通し。

教保証券のアナリスト、ペク・ユンミン氏は「市場予想に盲目的に従わないという総裁の発言は、最終到達金利が３．５０％になることに疑問を呈したと解釈すべきではない。むしろ、実際の利上げの道筋が、予想されている１１月と来年第１・四半期という日程とは異なる可能性を示している」と指摘。「１１月の利上げを見送ることにはリスクがある。インフレ抑制に向けた断固たる姿勢を示すには、利上げの実施が重要だからだ」と述べた。

３年物国債先物はほぼ横ばい。市場では、中銀が１１月にも追加利上げを実施する可能性を示唆することがおおむね織り込まれていた。

７月と８月の利上げは、韓国中銀にとって３年余りぶりの連続利上げだった。申氏はその後、引き締めは緩やかなペースで進めることが望ましいとの考えを示していた。

ただ、１０月１３日の国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のイベントでは、インフレ率が目標に収束するまで金融政策を制約的に維持すると改めて表明した。

９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）上昇率は２．９％と、８月の３．１％から鈍化したものの、中銀の目標である２％を引き続き上回った。

人工知能（ＡＩ）向けの世界的な支出を追い風に輸出は好調で、１─９月の輸出額は初めて８０００億ドルを突破した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：韓国半導体大手2社の巨額還元、「コリア・ディスカウント」是正の試金石 アングル：韓国レバレッジ株式ＥＴＦ、規制措置導入でも100億ドル超が流入 アングル：韓国個人投資家、7月の国内株暴落で米国株投資再び加速 アングル：韓国、個人のレバレッジ投資ブームに試練　株急落で含み損拡大 焦点：韓国の通貨安定化、国内の米国株投資熱で苦境 最終更新: 10/22(木) 14:13 ロイター

Bank of Korea holds rates after back-to-back hikes

The buliding of Bank of Korea is seen in Seoul, South Korea. (File photo: Reuters/Kim Hong-Ji)

22 Oct 2026 09:06AM (Updated: 22 Oct 2026 11:05AM)

FAST

SEOUL: The Bank of Korea kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged on Thursday (Oct 22) but maintained a hawkish stance by upgrading its economic growth forecasts and remaining upbeat about the country's export momentum. The seven-member monetary policy board at the BOK voted to keep the seven-day repurchase rate at 3 per cent, a decision that was forecast by all 34 analysts surveyed by Reuters. The central bank said that further tightening remains on the table, stating it "will decide the timing and pace of future increases" while assessing inflation, financial stability and domestic economic trends. "The growth rates for this year and next year are expected to be considerably higher than the August forecasts of 3.3 per cent and 2.9 per cent, respectively," the BOK said in a statement, adding a pause on Thursday was needed to evaluate external risks and the lagging effects of its back-to-back hikes in July and August.

It also said that both headline inflation and core inflation for next year will exceed its previous forecasts. "The Bank of Korea left its policy rate unchanged at 3 per cent at today’s meeting, but we doubt this marks the end of the tightening cycle, and have pencilled in one hike for the BOK’s final meeting of the year in November," Gareth Leather, an analyst at Capital Economics said in a note after the decision. The July and August increases were the central bank's first consecutive hikes in more than three years, after which Governor Shin Hyun Song said a gradual pace of tightening was preferred. Shin, however, reiterated at an International Monetary Fund event on Oct 13 that policy would remain restrictive until inflation converges to its target. Headline consumer inflation slowed to 2.9 per cent in September from 3.1 per cent in August, remaining above the bank's 2 per cent target. Exports are powering ahead thanks to global spending on artificial intelligence. Shipments from January to September topped US$800 billion for the first time ever. With growth expected to remain firm and inflation above target, median forecasts in the survey showed the BOK raising its base rate to 3.25 per cent at its November meeting, in line with the BOK's dot plot projection. Shin will hold a news conference at 0210 GMT (10.10am Singapore time).

Source: Reuters/nh

Japan funding conditions still loose despite interest rate hikes, survey shows

Japanese 10,000 yen and 1,000 yen banknotes are displayed in this illustration taken on Oct 20, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon)

FAST

TOKYO: Major Japanese lenders see increased demand for funds among corporate borrowers compared with three months ago, a survey showed on Thursday (Oct 22), indicating the central bank's recent interest rate hikes have yet to tighten financial conditions. Financial conditions are becoming increasingly important in predicting the timing of the Bank of Japan's next rate hike. The bank has said it will scrutinise how past increases affect corporate funding to assess how close its rate is from a level it deems neutral to the economy. In a survey, that the BOJ conducted over Sep 9 through Oct 13, a diffusion index measuring the ratio of major banks that saw corporate fund demand rise versus those seeing demand shrink stood at +3, compared with -1 in a survey three months earlier. A positive reading indicates more banks saw corporate fund demand increase compared with those that saw demand fall. The BOJ raised its policy interest rate to a 31-year high of 1.25 per cent on Sep 18 and signalled a pivot towards a policy focusing on forestalling risk of inflation overshooting its 2 per cent target.

Source: Reuters/ec

item.title: Russia pounds Kyiv, Ukraine launches drones, despite talk of renewing negotiations
item.description: Ukraine said Russia fired at least 21 ballistic missiles in three waves. Russia said Ukraine launched 630 drones towards the capital Moscow during the night.
item.dc:creator: Olena Harmash, Gleb Bryanski
item.content:encoded: Russia pounded Kyiv with ballistic missiles and Ukraine sent hundreds of drones towards Moscow overnight as the warring sides kept up a barrage of attacks despite the latest US push to end the conflict. Russia said on Wednesday it was ready to resume US-mediated talks with Ukraine next month, after President Vladimir Putin hosted US envoy Steve Witkoff for talks in St Petersburg. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy [USN:L1N4670ZQ TEXT:"said he hoped"] negotiations, which would be the first since February, would take place early in November. Ukraine said Russia fired at least 21 ballistic missiles in three waves. Russia said Ukraine launched 630 drones towards the capital Moscow during the night. The two sides held an exchange of war dead, with Moscow handing over 252 bodies and Ukraine handing over 25, according to the Belta state news agency in neighbouring Belarus. Such exchanges have accompanied moves towards talks in the past. But while Witkoff spoke of "some degree of momentum" after meeting Zelenskiy and European and NATO officials in Oslo earlier in the week, the Kremlin expressed doubts. "The Americans sensed some new nuances (in Oslo) and told us about this. But these nuances, so to speak, do not entirely satisfy us," Kremlin aide Yuri Ushakov said. A senior Russian official, briefed on the results of the Putin-Witkoff talks, said they were relatively short and not substantive. The American brought a set of proposals drafted in Oslo and handed them to Putin for review, the person said. Another source close to the Kremlin said the US proposals included a scenario where Ukraine would cede all of its Donbas region to Russia in return for receiving a guarantee of its future security from NATO. Russia says it launched the war, the deadliest in Europe since World War Two, in part to prevent Ukraine from joining NATO. It has repeatedly said it would not end fighting unless Ukraine cedes more land, limits the size of its forces and is permanently barred from forming alliances. Ukraine, which says the invasion was an unprovoked war of conquest, has long dismissed Russia's conditions as a demand for capitulation that would leave it defenceless against future Russian attacks. US PRAISE FOR 'HUMANITARIAN' PUTIN GOES DOWN BADLY WITH KYIV Zelenskiy's meeting with Witkoff was aimed in part at smoothing over a deterioration in relations with Washington this month, after President Donald Trump announced a deal to buy Russian diesel and lifted sanctions on Moscow. Kyiv says Washington failed to provide early-warning data on Russian missile launches, throttled the SpaceX satellite system used to guide Ukrainian drones, and withheld missile defence systems bought on its behalf by Europeans. Washington denies any shift in policy to intentionally hamper Ukraine's forces. Trump has repeatedly rebuked Ukraine for attacking Russian oil refineries while saying little about far deadlier Russian attacks on Ukraine. He called for Zelenskiy to be replaced and said Russia's actions in Ukraine have been "fine". Zelenskiy, who long avoided any criticism of the Trump administration, has increasingly pushed back against what he describes as a shift towards sympathy with Moscow. On Thursday Zelenskiy snapped back at Witkoff for saluting Putin as a "humanitarian" during his visit to Russia, when the US envoy thanked Putin for [USN:L8N4670PP TEXT:"releasing a 74-year-old American"] captured by Russian forces in Ukraine. "Three waves of ballistic missiles have been launched at Kyiv by Russian 'humanitarians' since yesterday evening," Zelenskiy posted on X. "They used 21 missiles. Unfortunately, numerous sites across the city have been hit and damaged." He said 2 people were killed and 34 injured, including five children, in attacks on a dozen Ukrainian regions. Russia said it carried out a "massive strike" overnight on port infrastructure in Ukraine's Odesa region, as well as on vessels used by the Ukrainian military. In Russia, two people were wounded near Moscow by drones launched towards the capital during the night, Mayor Sergei Sobyanin [USN:P8N44K018 TEXT:"said"] on Telegram. Most of the drones were downed at long range, he added. In the Russian border region of Belgorod, one man was killed and another wounded by Ukrainian drones, local officials said. With the frontlines of the war largely static, both sides have escalated long-range air strikes this year. Russia has particularly targeted the Ukrainian power grid, while Ukraine has aimed at Russian oil refineries. Both have struck data centres, commercial warehouses and Black Sea shipping. The war has ground on for more than 4-1/2 years, defying Trump's pledge during his 2024 election campaign that he could end it in a day. No breakthrough emerged from three short meetings in Istanbul last year and three rounds of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi and Geneva at the start of this year.

item.title: Austrian and Swiss women freed after 18 months in Niger reach Benghazi, sources say
item.description: An Austrian woman and a Swiss woman arrived in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi after being freed from more than 18 months of detention in Niger, two officials speaking on the condition of anonymity said on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: An Austrian woman and a Swiss woman arrived in the eastern Libyan city of Benghazi after being freed from more than 18 months of detention in Niger, two officials speaking on the condition of anonymity said on Wednesday. [USN:L1N4530IW TEXT:"The Austrian"], identified by Austrian authorities as Eva G, who is in her 70s, was kidnapped in the desert town of Agadez in central Niger in January 2025. Little information has been released about which group was holding her or what demands they may have made. She had been living in Niger for years. The Swiss woman was taken hostage in April 2025. Without naming her, Swiss Foreign Minister Ignazio Cassis confirmed in a post on X that the woman had been freed and said she was on her way back to Switzerland. His ministry said the government formed a task force after her capture, including police and intelligence services, and that it had stayed in regular contact with Austria. The ministry said that for reasons of privacy protection it would not provide more details about the case. The Austrian Foreign Ministry separately confirmed the release of Eva G after what it called a "long, complex, and highly sensitive diplomatic process." The two officials said the women were handed over to authorities from their respective countries and that the operation was overseen by Saddam Haftar, deputy commander-in-chief of Libya's armed forces. Niger, like its neighbours Mali and Burkina Faso, is battling a jihadist insurgency linked to al Qaeda and Islamic State that spun out of a Tuareg rebellion in northern Mali in 2012. The fighting has killed thousands and displaced millions across West Africa's central Sahel region over the past decade. Kidnappings appeared to intensify in Niger last year.

item.title: Meta puts Muse agent at heart of AI strategy
item.description: More than 10 million people in the US and Canada have set up Muse accounts in a month and a half.

Meta puts Muse agent at heart of AI strategy

More than 10 million people in the US and Canada have set up Muse accounts in a month and a half.

Meta’s Muse Charm offers real-time voice and avatar interaction in a small standalone device that does not require a phone. (Photo: Meta)

FAST

Meta introduced new non-voting shares on Wednesday (Oct 21) to help fund the social media giant's costly AI expansion, as executives laid out their vision for organising the company's future around its nascent AI agent business. Shares of the Facebook and Instagram parent rose more than 4 per cent in extended trading. Meta also forecast fourth-quarter revenue above Wall Street estimates and reported strong growth of its new consumer AI agent app Muse. The company has been pouring money into advanced chips and data centres to compete more aggressively with AI market leaders OpenAI and Anthropic, propelling it to the vanguard of an emerging consumer AI agent race while also eroding its historically strong free cash flow. Meta will issue a new class of non-voting Class C common stock in January 2027, effectively resulting in a two-for-one split, to fund acquisitions and retain top talent while maintaining CEO Mark Zuckerberg's control.

Zuckerberg said more than 10 million people in the US and Canada have set up Muse accounts in a month and a half and growth remained strong. He said he expected Muse would eventually serve "billions of people" who would potentially generate more revenue than the average Meta user, forecasting the venture would give rise to the kind of network effect that helped build his social media empire. "Part of the reason why we're not just charging everyone up front to use this is we want to establish this Muse network, and we think that it's going to be more valuable for people at scale when there are a lot of people and businesses using Muse," Zuckerberg said on a conference call after Meta published its third-quarter financial report.

Related:

Commentary: Zuckerberg’s ‘Tamagotchi-like’ AI could be Meta’s iPod moment

HIGHER COSTS Still, Zuckerberg acknowledged that the costs of offering Muse were higher than those associated with many of Meta's other new products over the years, and said the company would move to monetise the agent "somewhat sooner on this than our normal playbook". Meta CFO Susan Li forecast the company's AI businesses would begin contributing incremental revenue in 2027 and become "a meaningful source of revenue diversification over time". The executives also emphasised that AI would be the focus moving forward for Meta’s loss-making Reality Labs unit, which had led the charge on the company’s vision to build the “metaverse”, an immersive digital world that inspired its name change from Facebook to Meta in 2021. In their financial report, they said they “remain focused on improving Reality Labs profitability” and forecast its losses would narrow next year to around US$15 billion “as we reallocate investment toward other priority areas, primarily AI”. The company raised the lower end of its annual spending forecast, now expecting capital expenditure to be between US$135 billion and US$145 billion this year, up from US$130 billion to US$145 billion expected previously. It reported a free cash flow deficit of US$2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with positive free cash flow of US$10.63 billion a year earlier. Revenue for the third quarter came in better than expected at US$64.60 billion, ahead of Wall Street estimates of US$63.37 billion, according to data compiled by LSEG. Meta also projected fourth-quarter revenue between US$73 billion and US$76 billion, above estimates of US$73.73 billion. The early popularity of Muse and the release of a competitive new series of AI models have helped Meta justify its spending to investors, even though some enterprises are restricting the agent's access over security concerns. "The market has shifted from punishing Meta for spending to rewarding it for having a compelling product story," said Jesse Cohen, senior analyst at Investing.com.

Related:

Judge orders Meta to pay US$25 billion to New Mexico in Cambridge Analytica case

LEGAL CHALLENGES Legal challenges are mounting, including a US$25 billion penalty ordered by a judge in New Mexico earlier on Wednesday after a jury found Meta misled the state's residents about how it shared user data with third parties and enforced policies on hate speech and misinformation in a case related to British political consulting firm Cambridge Analytica. The US$25 billion penalty is a "stark reminder of the current legal challenges Meta faces, which will continue into next year", Emarketer senior analyst Minda Smiley said. "Questions and concerns related to privacy and safety will only ramp up should AI agents become more mainstream, which could ultimately hurt Meta considering its reputation in this area." In August, Meta agreed to pay as much as US$18 billion over a decade and restrict teenagers' use of Facebook and Instagram to settle claims by nearly all US states alleging that Meta's platforms were designed to addict children. Meta posted diluted earnings per share of US$3.83 in the quarter, a figure that would have been US$7.40 had it not been for a US$9.89 billion charge related to the August settlement. The agreement removed a significant regulatory hurdle that had weighed on Meta's stock and allowed the company to avoid a potentially lengthy trial that could have exposed more internal documents about its treatment of young users. Still, Meta warned in its guidance on Wednesday that it continued to face scrutiny and US trials around "youth-related issues" that could impact its financial results.

Source: Reuters/aj

item.title: Websites taken offline over PHP risks
item.description: Organizations rushed to protect themselves.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Several government, school and hospital websites in Europe were [USN:L6N4670DM TEXT:"taken offline"] on Wednesday as organizations rushed to protect themselves from two critical security flaws in PHP, a programming language that powers a large share of the internet. Cybersecurity agencies across the world have warned that organizations unable to apply fixes in time should consider taking affected sites offline. PHP's developers said a set of [USN:S8N45U0DC TEXT:"new"] updates fixing two previously identified critical vulnerabilities was available. Here are some major websites and services taken offline or otherwise affected: GERMANY A spokesperson for the German digital ministry [USN:L8N4671P9 TEXT:"said"] on Wednesday the federal IT service provider ITZBund had taken several websites offline due to the discovery of PHP vulnerabilities. The temporary deactivation was purely preventive and no security incidents were known to have occurred, the spokesperson said. FRANCE The Interior Ministry said it had [USN:S8N44907T TEXT:"temporarily taken offline the websites"] of prefectures, which are local government administrative offices, while awaiting a security fix for the PHP framework they use. It said the move was a precaution pending a patch from the framework's publisher. BELGIUM Belgium's [USN:FWN46718F TEXT:"foreign ministry"] said it had temporarily taken its websites offline following reports of cyberattacks exploiting the PHP vulnerabilities, although the country's cybersecurity centre said it had not recorded any attacks on Belgian websites. NETHERLANDS [USN:L6N4670DM TEXT:"Many organizations"] followed the example of the National Cyber Security Centre and preventively took their public-facing sites offline. They included the Port of Rotterdam, government site Overheid.nl, the national football association KNVB, the websites of the five largest political parties and numerous hospital websites across the country. FINLAND State IT centre Valtori [USN:S8N3WF054 TEXT:"shut down"] the government's public web services on Wednesday as "a precautionary measure." Valtori said it had not identified any attempt to exploit the flaws and that the outage was not the result of a data breach. CZECH REPUBLIC The Czech government took its website offline on Wednesday at 7 p.m. (1700 GMT) at the recommendation of the country's cyber watchdog to "allow for the implementation of necessary security patches." "The measure aims to ensure the secure operation of the website. During the shutdown, the site and its content will not be accessible to the public. Services will be restored once the recommended security updates have been applied," the government office said. WIKIMEDIA [USN:S8N45U0DD TEXT:"The Wikimedia Foundation"], which runs online encyclopedia Wikipedia, said it was in the process of addressing security vulnerabilities in the PHP programming language. All foundation-supported systems and volunteer-run systems that use PHP are affected, the foundation said in a statement. "We have taken down a number of other systems as a precautionary measure until they can be safely patched," the foundation added.

item.title: Russia says it will send first diesel cargo to US on Thursday
item.description: Russia lifted its self-imposed ban on diesel exports on Oct 9, introduced to tackle domestic shortages triggered by Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries, after reaching the deal with US President Donald Trump to supply diesel to global markets.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Russia says it will send first diesel cargo to US on Thursday

Russia lifted its self-imposed ban on diesel exports on Oct 9, introduced to tackle domestic shortages triggered by Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries, after reaching the deal with US President Donald Trump to supply diesel to global markets.

Russia's Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak speaks during a session of the Russian Energy Week international forum in Moscow, Russia, Oct 15, 2025. (Photo: Reuters/Ramil Sitdikov)

MOSCOW: Russia will dispatch its first tanker with diesel for the United States on Thursday (Oct 22), Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak said, according to the Vedomosti news outlet, after a deal with US President Donald Trump. Russia lifted its self-imposed ban on diesel exports on Oct 9, introduced to tackle domestic shortages triggered by Ukrainian drone attacks on refineries, after reaching the deal with Trump to supply diesel to global markets. Novak said on Wednesday the vessel will carry 40,000 metric tons of the fuel, adding that the paperwork on the fuel supply is nearing its completion, according to media reports. He did not name the port from which the cargo will be delivered. "Additional shipments will follow, of course. There were agreements reached between the two leaders. We will meet the United States' needs, to the extent of our capabilities," RIA news agency quoted Novak as saying.

Trump has said Russia would immediately export 300,000 metric tons, or 2.25 million barrels, followed by 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons "immediately thereafter". The US exports about 1.5 million barrels of diesel per day. Russian President Vladimir Putin was hosting US special envoy Steve Witkoff on Wednesday, after the US-Russia diesel export deal led to a sharp deterioration in ties between the United States and Ukraine. During the talks in St Petersburg, Witkoff thanked Putin for lifting the export restrictions. Putin also mentioned the deal, saying that global diesel prices dropped by 5 per cent to 6 per cent after the agreement. "That's an example of us working together, I want to thank you for that," Witkoff said in televised comments. Putin also said that first Russian tankers with diesel will departs in two to three days. "We are preparing deliveries of several vessels, the tankers, right now. They will go one after another. The financial component should be provided," he said, adding that Russia also would be able to supply fertilisers in "large quantities" to the US market.

item.title: Putin hosts Trump envoy for new Ukraine peace talks, frees US citizen held in Russia
item.description: Stephen Hubbard, a 74-year-old retired US school teacher who had been held in Russia on mercenary charges, has been released.
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:
Advertisement

World

Putin hosts Trump envoy for new Ukraine peace talks, frees US citizen held in Russia

Stephen Hubbard, a 74-year-old retired US school teacher who had been held in Russia on mercenary charges, has been released.

Russian presidential envoy Kirill Dmitriev greets US special envoy Steve Witkoff upon his arrival at Pulkovo Airport in Saint Petersburg, Russia on Oct 21, 2026. (Photo: Reuters)

ST PETERSBURG, Russia: President Vladimir Putin hosted US Special Envoy Steve Witkoff in a grand imperial palace on Wednesday (Oct 21) to review new ideas on ending the war in Ukraine amid Washington's latest push to stop Europe's bloodiest conflict since World War Two. The talks in St Petersburg , the ninth time that Witkoff has met Putin in person, began with a goodwill gesture from Russia - the release of a retired US school teacher held in Russia. The encounter comes amid concerns in Kyiv and among its allies that the United States is backing away from Ukraine, at times holding back real-time intelligence on Russian attacks and hobbling Ukraine's military communications. The latest talks came more than two years since US President Donald Trump promised in his successful election campaign to end the Ukraine war within 24 hours.
